properties.description: From azure sql db to adls parquet file Incremental/backdated data Ingestion

text.value:
Select sum(incr_rows) as incr_rows From
(Select count(*) as incr_rows From dbo.Orders
Where last_updated > '@{activity('Lookup CDC Dates').output.value[0].max_cdc_timestamp}'
union all
Select count(*) as incr_rows From dbo.Orders
Where last_updated <
'@{activity('Lookup CDC Dates').output.value[0].min_cdc_timestamp}' ) as tbl

Where last_updated < '@{activity('Lookup CDC Dates').output.value[0].min_cdc_timestamp}'
